name: web-google-calendar-sharing-feature-section-with-check-list-and-photo
title: Feature block: Google icon arc, calendar preview, tick list and a synagogue photo card
whatItIs: A white 'UI Elements' page with a Google-app icon arc leading to a large G, a tall rounded photo of a synagogue with a round icon and label, a light-blue calendar card highlighting Google Calendar, and a white card with tick items and three small feature tiles linked by arrows.
whatItMeans: Clear and trustworthy; familiar logos and tick lists make integration easy to grasp.
techniques: Arrange partner icons in an arc around a hero logo.
Combine a tall documentary photo with UI cards.
Highlight one card with a blue border.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a coloured border to stand out.
A small card explaining one capability.
